root_idea.summary: A root centered on height, elevation, loftiness, and being above.
root_idea.development: Its physical sense of rising or being high extends to superiority, eminence, mastery, exaltation, and—when morally marked—self-aggrandizement or tyranny. Related forms also designate upper parts, elevated places, and things added above a load.

senses.definition: To rise, become high, or be elevated.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of physical or abstract elevation; the supplied QAC group also contains the surface form تَعَالَى.

senses.definition: To rise above, prevail over, or gain mastery of something or someone.
senses.usage_conditions: The object may be a rival, an affair, or another power; the sense is one of ascendancy rather than mere physical height.

senses.definition: To exalt oneself, behave arrogantly, or act oppressively from a position of superiority.
senses.usage_conditions: This is the blameworthy use of elevation, especially in constructions with عَلَا فِي الأَرْضِ or عَلَا عَلَى.

senses.definition: To be exalted above created beings; said of God, to be transcendent in essence and attributes.
senses.usage_conditions: This Quranic divine use is represented by the supplied تَعَالَى surface forms within the same QAC Form-I group.

senses.definition: Come; come forward or come to the proposed matter.
senses.usage_conditions: A fixed imperative expression, originally associated with ascending toward the person addressed but conventionally used regardless of relative location; it is used with singular, dual, and plural forms.

senses.definition: To seek or gain superiority; to prevail over or overcome.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence is in a contest in which one party is expected to prevail; the form can also denote superiority perceptible to the senses or conceived by the intellect.

senses.definition: Higher, highest, or superior; the Most High.
senses.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally or substantivally for the highest degree of elevation, excellence, or superiority; in divine usage it denotes absolute highness.

senses.definition: The higher ones; those who are superior or destined to prevail.
senses.usage_conditions: A plural designation of superiority in rank or outcome, not merely physical height.

senses.definition: High, elevated, or above; occupying the upper or highest part.
senses.usage_conditions: Includes the active-participle forms عَالِيًا, عَالِيَهَا, عَالِيَهُمْ, and the plural عَالِينَ. The elevation may be spatial or descriptive.

senses.definition: Exalted in a domineering or overbearing position.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic description of Pharaoh, the elevation is morally marked as oppressive earthly ascendancy.
Feminine adjective describing an elevated state or position.

senses.definition: High, elevated, or exalted in rank; noble.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of persons, things, or status; it is distinct from the active participle عَالٍ.

senses.definition: The Most High, beyond the reach of encompassing description.
senses.usage_conditions: A divine epithet expressing transcendent highness rather than a merely comparative height.

senses.definition: Illiyyin: an indefinitely elevated realm associated with the righteous.
senses.usage_conditions: The term is variously explained as the highest heaven or paradise, the place or register to which the righteous deeds or souls ascend, or the inhabitants of that realm; the supplied evidence does not resolve these interpretations into one exclusive referent.

senses.definition: High, highest, or superior; the uppermost level or quality.
senses.usage_conditions: Feminine counterpart of أَعْلَى, used adjectivally and as a substantive for what is highest.
The abstract noun may denote physical height or elevation in rank.
A blameworthy abstract elevation, especially when exercised against others or in the earth.

senses.definition: The One exalted above all; the Most High.
senses.usage_conditions: A divine epithet emphasizing superiority over every high one and transcendence above created attributes and false imputations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ascend a place, climb onto it, or mount an animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete upward movement; the object may be a mountain, roof, or beast.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lie upon, overlay, overspread, or weigh upon something as a burden.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a thing becoming superincumbent or onerous.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be superior to others in nobility, beauty, or distinction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative social or personal superiority, not necessarily domination.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The windward side or quarter from which the wind blows.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with reference to a person, game, or object exposed to the wind.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strike, set upon, or assail someone with a weapon, abuse, or beating.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic extension of attacking from above or upon.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To recoil from, shrink from, or fail to cleave to something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Often said of the eye recoiling from an objectionable person or thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To raise, put upon, lift from, or otherwise handle a load by lifting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes raising goods onto a beast, raising a bucket or rope, and removing goods from a beast.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Vying, competing, or contending for superiority or eminence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal contest in highness, loftiness, rank, or distinction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rise during the working or heating of clarified butter or fat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of a substance rising in preparation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a death announcement public or conspicuous.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic raising or spreading of news of someone’s death.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Go away, move aside, or seek the desired object from someone else.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An imperative or idiomatic dismissal, sometimes accompanied by inability to provide what is requested.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To raise, elevate, or make a thing high or lofty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Transitive causation of elevation, including figurative elevation of a person’s rank.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sit upon a cushion, or to rise from it; to alight from a beast.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The preposition or complement distinguishes sitting upon from rising away or alighting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become high or elevated gradually, gently, or leisurely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reflexive or intransitive development of elevation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To come upon a group suddenly or without permission.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized idiomatic use distinct from physical ascent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To recover or become purified after childbirth; of a man, to recover from illness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The postpartum use is conventionally applied to a woman, while the illness use may be applied to a man.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ascend or climb; in transitive use, to mount or rise upon something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The supplied entry points to both transitive and intransitive uses of the upward-motion branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fall short in an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately reported use associated with اِئْتَلَى, not a synonym for physical ascent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be frequently current on the tongue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a word or sentence that is habitually uttered.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a race, to outstrip competitors and reach the goal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional equestrian or racing expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put a superscription or title on a book or writing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The associated nouns عَلْوَنَة and عُلْوَان designate the title or heading.

other_classical_meanings.definition: From above or from the higher part; figuratively, from a position of superiority and hence overcoming or subduing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The vowel and grammatical form vary between the fixed adverbial expressions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A high or elevated state of the base or foundation of a building.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized architectural use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take someone or something by force.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiom of forcible taking, related to superiority over the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The higher or highest part of a house, abode, or thing; by extension, a high class of poetry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The same noun may denote an upper location or elevated quality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Above or over, used as a noun in the expression مِنْ عَلَيْهِ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the lexical noun meaning “the place above,” distinct from the many grammatical prepositional functions of عَلَى.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An imperative expression meaning take hold of or keep to something; in another construction, bring or present something to me.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are fixed verbal-noun constructions rather than ordinary spatial uses of the preposition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An anvil, whether of iron, stone, or another hard material.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word also supplies the metaphorical basis for descriptions of hard or firm bodily make.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hard, firm, tall, or overtopping she-camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A metaphorical application from the hardness or elevation of an anvil; some authorities emphasize height and bulk.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A stone or platform used for drying or cooking the preparation called أَقِط.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical pastoral term for the supporting stone or prepared cooking surface.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A vessel-like object used for milking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized implement made or arranged around a milking vessel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A high place, mountain summit, or the sky.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantive for a naturally elevated location or the upper realm.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A high or eminent deed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use in which moral or social elevation belongs to an action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Relating to the region called al-ʿĀliyah.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A regional adjective or nisbah, not simply the general adjective “high.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: Tall and corpulent, bulky, or large-bodied.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a man, woman, or camel according to the cited usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A male hyena, or a tall hyena.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A high or loud voice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use for elevated vocal sound.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Household goods, furniture, or utensils.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported lexical use synonymous with مَتَاع.

other_classical_meanings.definition: High or eminent rank, station, nobility, or the acquisition of such distinction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related مَعْلَاة is the means or cause of acquiring honor; the abstract noun itself denotes the elevated status.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An eminent or high-ranking person; the elite of a people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural or quasi-plural social designation, distinct from the general adjective “high.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: Strong, robust, or powerful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A physical or personal quality, sometimes motivating its use as a personal name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: People dwelling in high parts of a country, or people possessing opulence and eminence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical plural opposed to those of the lower parts or lower social standing; it is distinct from the Quranic term عِلِّيِّين.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel strong enough to bear her burden and excelling in capacity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized camel epithet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man who behaves effeminately toward women.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized and socially marked idiomatic use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An upper chamber or room in an uppermost story.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete architectural noun, with plural عَلَالِي.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The board supporting an assay balance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare technical meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An additional load placed above a completed load, or any superaddition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes goods put on a camel after its main load and anything given over and above an amount.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The uppermost part of the head or neck; the head or neck itself in idiomatic expressions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Often occurs in expressions for striking or severing the head.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The upper portion of a spear shaft, especially the part near or entering the iron head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Contrasted with the lower portion, سَافِلَة; the exact extent varies among authorities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The upper part of a valley from which its water descends.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographical topographic term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The elevated region above Najd or the higher part of the Hijaz, including associated settlements.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A regional proper designation, not a general adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of higher authority, more approved, more eloquent, usual, or common.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a word, form, or linguistic expression in comparative evaluation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More knowledgeable or better acquainted with someone’s condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiom using elevation for superior knowledge or awareness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To esteem, magnify, or honor someone greatly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative idiom of holding someone in high regard.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The higher hand, especially the abstaining or giving hand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional ethical or social expression contrasting the giving or self-restaining hand with the receiving hand.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The seventh and most valuable arrow in the game of maysir.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: When it wins, it receives seven shares; the term is a specialized gambling designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The milker standing on the left side of a milch camel, or the person handling the vessel while milking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The exact division of labor varies in the cited descriptions; it is opposed to البائن.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having ability, power, or strength sufficient for an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of being able to rise to or master a task.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The lion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A zoological metaphor based on strength and power.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Not falling short, remiss, or deficient in carrying out what is required.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate idiomatic use associated with being adequate to an affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The near or left side of a she-camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression for approaching the animal from that side.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The hand of one who takes by force, plunders, or seizes openly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional contrast with the concealed or furtive hand in legal discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The “high” letters خ، ص، ض، ط، ظ، غ، ق, articulated with elevation of the tongue toward the palate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical phonetic classification opposed to the lowered letters.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A name for the sweet food called الفَالُوذَجُ or الفَالُوذ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized lexical name for a sweet food.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The upper lip.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional anatomical expression using عُلْيَا for the upper member of a pair.

cautions: The supplied QAC Form-I group qac-form:Elw:taEa`laY` combines surface forms عَلَا, تَعْلُ, and تَعَالَى; this artifact preserves that grouping while displaying the normalized citation form عَلَا and separately displaying the supplied imperative group.

عِلِّيِّين has several classical interpretations in the packet, including an elevated realm, paradise, its inhabitants, or a register associated with the righteous; no single interpretation is asserted as exclusive.
The English contextual glosses are used only as examples and orientation; lexical senses are supported by Lane and/or Mufradat.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The supplied evidence reports divergent traditional analyses of عِلِّيِّين, including whether it is a place, a register, inhabitants, or an unbounded plural; these alternatives are retained in the Quranic usage conditions.
Some rare Lane entries contain competing readings or attributional alternatives, especially for عِلْيَانٌ, عَلْيَآءُ, and regional terms; they are synthesized only where the lexical branch is clear.
